items.title: CFTC dual framework would treat exchange-traded event contracts as swaps, bookmaker bets as gambling
items.content_text: - **CFTC dual framework would treat exchange-traded event contracts as swaps, bookmaker bets as gambling** — The framework described in the report distinguishes products by market structure rather than event type. Contracts traded on multi-sided exchanges where holders can resell positions may be treated as swaps, while house-set bookmaker bets are treated as gambling. items.content_text: - **Portugal blocks Polymarket after election betting surge** — Portugal's gambling regulator SRIJ ordered Polymarket to halt operations, saying political event markets are not permitted under rules that limit online gambling to licensed sports betting, casino games and horse racing.
